variants.html: • A String is moved from draft into archive. When the scope containing archive ends, which binding is responsible for dropping the value?

criteria.description: Identifies the new owner as responsible for releasing the moved value when its scope ends.

rubric.full: The archive binding owns the value after the move and drops it when that scope ends.
rubric.partial: The old draft binding no longer owns the value.

variants.html: • A function takes ownership of a Vec<i32> passed by value. Explain who releases the vector's allocation when the function returns.

criteria.description: States that the function's parameter owns the vector after the move.
Explains that the vector is dropped and its allocation released when the function scope ends.

rubric.expected: The function's parameter owns the vector after the move and drops it when the function returns, releasing its allocation.
rubric.full: Explains that ownership moves to the function parameter and that it releases the vector when its scope ends.
rubric.partial: Credit only if it correctly identifies either the new owner or the release at function return.
